meta.name: lemlist-campaign-from-icp
meta.description: Use when the user says "create a lemlist campaign for X", "build a lemlist campaign from this ICP", "spin a lemlist campaign for Y", "ICP to lemlist", "natural language to lemlist campaign", "draft a lemlist campaign", "lemlist campaign for VPs/Managers/ICs at Z", or any variant indicating they want to turn a natural-language ICP description into a paused, ready-to-review lemlist campaign with sourced leads and a seniority-routed sequence. Orchestrates 24 lemlist atomic skills (ICP, persona, sourcing, copywriting, QA) and the lemlist MCP server (`get_lemleads_filters`, `lemleads_search`, `create_campaign_with_sequence`, `add_sequence_step`, `add_lead_to_campaign`, `validate_campaign_readiness`) into one end-to-end loop. Hard approval gate before the MCP push — never auto-sends. Depends on the 24 lemlist atomic skills under `.claude/skills/lemlist/` and the lemlist MCP server declared in `.mcp.json` — fails fast if either is missing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将理想客户画像自动转为可审阅的lemlist营销活动
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要用理想客户画像快速搭建lemlist邮件营销活动
copy.tagline_en: Turn ideal customer profiles into ready-to-review lemlist campaigns
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to quickly build a lemlist campaign from an ideal customer profile

howto.what: 当你给出一个理想客户画像（ICP）的自然语言描述，Claude 会自动执行一系列步骤：定义 ICP 和人物画像、搜索潜在客户、编写邮件序列，最终在 Lemlist 中创建一个暂停状态的推广活动，供你审查后再启动。全程需要你手动确认每个关键步骤，不会自动发送邮件。
howto.when: 当你用「为……创建一个 Lemlist 活动」「根据这个 ICP 构建一封邮件序列」「把 ICP 转换成 Lemlist 活动」等表述，或者任何表明你想把自然语言描述的 ICP 变成一个 Lemlist 活动时触发。

say.text: 为 SaaS 行业的 VP 级别销售负责人创建一个 Lemlist 活动。
say.note: Claude 会开始分析 ICP 并生成活动草稿。

say.text: 用这个 ICP 帮我构建一封邮件序列：目标客户是欧洲的 HR 技术公司经理。
say.note: Claude 会根据你提供的 ICP 生成序列。

say.text: 把以下自然语言描述转换成 Lemlist 活动：……
say.note: 粘贴 ICP 描述后，Claude 会生成暂停的草稿活动。
